name: com.mux.sdk.webrtc.spaces.internal.impl.capturers.screencapture.ScreenCaptureService
description: Mux Spaces’ real-time video SDK binds this foreground Service when screen sharing starts after Android’s screen-capture prompt is approved. It keeps the shared-screen capture running and displays a notification that the screen is being shared.
disableEffect: Screen sharing in Mux Spaces calls will not start.
